8.1 什么是解码
What is Decoding?

学习目标
Learning goals

Slide 0 (title page)

Deep Learning for NLP — Decoding Strategies — What is Decoding?

Learning goals

  • Get to know the concept of decoding in NLP
  • Learn about different decoding strategies

目标: 了解 NLP 中解码 (decoding) 的概念; 认识不同的解码策略.

Slide 1

Reminder: ARLM

  • In Autoregressive Language Modeling (ARLM) the model predicts the next token given the previous tokens
  • Given the context a language model produces a probability distribution over all the tokens in the vocabulary
  • The context is the prompt given to the model plus the already generated tokens
  • The way we then choose the next token from that probability distribution to generate natural text is called a decoding strategy

回顾自回归语言建模 (4.1 节): 模型根据前面的词元预测下一个词元; 给定上下文 (提示 + 已经生成的词元), 模型输出整个词表上的概率分布. 从这个分布里怎样选出下一个词元, 叫做解码策略. 模型只给分布, 解码策略决定实际输出什么.

Slide 2

Decoding example (1)

Prompt: Once upon a time

  • Time step 1: Model input: Once upon a time — Next token: there
  • Time step 2: Model input: Once upon a time there — Next token: was
  • Time step 3: Model input: Once upon a time there was — Next token: a
  • Time step 4: Model input: Once upon a time there was a — Next token: cat
  • ...

例: 提示「Once upon a time」 (从前). 每个时间步, 把当前全部文本送进模型, 选出一个新词元接在后面, 作为下一步的输入: there → was → a → cat → ……

Slide 3

Decoding example (2)

(Abbildung identisch mit 4.1 Slide 2: Verteilungen P(w1​∣w0​)…P(w6​∣w0​…w5​) für 「the dog chases a cat .」.)

  • At each timestep the model produces a probability distribution
  • A decoding strategy determines how to choose the next token from that distribution, that token is then added to the context
  • Generation stops based on stopping criteria (see: next slide)

图同 4.1 Slide 2. 每一步模型给出一个分布; 解码策略从中选一个词元, 加进上下文; 满足停止条件时结束.

Slide 4

Stopping criteria for text generations

  • <EOS> Token: When this token is generated the model stops
  • Maximum Length: A predefined maximum length can be set for the generated text. When the text reaches this length, generation stops to prevent excessively long outputs
  • Maximum Time: A predefined maximum time for generation can be set. After this time has been reached, generation stops
  • Other Criteria: There are more stopping criteria implemented in huggingface

停止条件: 生成了结束符 <EOS>; 达到预设的最大长度 (防止输出过长); 达到预设的最长时间; Hugging Face 里还实现了其他条件 (如遇到指定的停止字符串).

Slide 5–6

Generate function

There is two types of hyperparameters for the generate() function of the Transformers library: One that controls the length of the ouput and one that controls the generation strategy used (huggingface, GenerationConfig):

  • You input a tokenized sentence as the context into the generate() function
  • And then control the length of the output with the following hyperparameters:
    • max_length: The maximum length the generated tokens can have. Corresponds to the length of the input prompt + max_new_tokens. Its effect is overridden by max_new_tokens, if also set
    • max_new_tokens: The maximum numbers of tokens to generate, ignoring the number of tokens in the prompt
    • min_length: The minimum length of the sequence to be generated. Corresponds to the length of the input prompt + min_new_tokens. Its effect is overridden by min_new_tokens, if also set
    • min_new_tokens: The minimum numbers of tokens to generate, ignoring the number of tokens in the prompt
    • max_time: The maximum amount of time you allow the computation to run for in seconds. generation will still finish the current pass after allocated time has been passed
  • With the second type of hyperparameters you control which of the following (see: next slide) decoding strategies you use (will be introduced in the following chapters)

Hugging Face Transformers 库的 generate() 有两类超参数: 控制输出长度的, 和选择解码策略的. 输入是分词后的提示. 长度相关:

  • max_length: 总长度上限 (包括提示), 相当于提示长度 + max_new_tokens; 两者都设时以 max_new_tokens 为准.
  • max_new_tokens: 最多新生成多少个词元, 不算提示.
  • min_length / min_new_tokens: 同理, 最小长度 (在此之前不允许生成 <EOS>).
  • max_time: 最多运行多少秒; 时间到了仍会把当前这一步算完.

易错: 提示很长时只设 max_length, 可能一个新词元都生成不了. 实践中一般用 max_new_tokens.

原文笔误: 「There is two types」应为 There are; 「ouput」应为 output.

Slide 7

Decoding strategies

Deterministic

  • Greedy search
  • Beam search
  • Contrastive search (Su et al., 2022)
  • Contrastive decoding (Li et al., 2023)

Stochastic

  • Sampling (with temperature)
  • Top-k sampling (Fan et al., 2018)
  • Nucleus top-p sampling (Holtzman et al., 2019)
  • Typical sampling (Meister et al., 2023)

Remark: Other decoding strategies exist, and various combinations are possible, such as top-k sampling with temperature, or top-p sampling followed by top-k sampling (with temperature), etc.

解码策略分两类:

  • 确定性: 同样的输入总得到同样的输出. 贪心搜索、束搜索 (8.2 节)、对比搜索、对比解码 (8.3 节).
  • 随机性: 每次运行结果可能不同. 带温度的采样、top-k 采样、核采样 (top-p)、典型采样 (8.3 节).

还有其他策略, 也可以组合: 例如 top-k 加温度, 或先 top-p 再 top-k 再加温度等.

8.2 贪心搜索与束搜索
Greedy & Beam Search

学习目标
Learning goals

Slide 0 (title page)

Deep Learning for NLP — Decoding Strategies — Greedy & Beam Search

Learning goals

  • Get to know deterministic decoding strategies
  • Learn how text is generated with greedy search and beam search
  • Understand how beam search tries to fix the drawbacks of greedy search

目标: 认识确定性解码策略; 学会用贪心搜索和束搜索生成文本; 理解束搜索怎样弥补贪心搜索的缺点.

贪心搜索
Greedy search

Slide 1
  • Core idea: Greedy search selects the word with the highest probability at each timestep, iteratively building the output sequence
  • Exploration of search space: It explores a single path through the output space, favoring the most probable word at each step without considering future consequences
  • Candidate Sequence: Only keeps track of the most likely sequence at each step, discarding other possibilities
  • Decision Making: It makes local decisions based solely on the highest probability at the current step without considering potential longer-term outcomes

Greedy search 贪心搜索: 每一步都选概率最大的词, 逐步构造输出. 只沿一条路径走, 不考虑后果; 只保留一个候选序列; 决策是局部的, 只看当前一步.

Slide 2
  • The model accepts an input sequence of tokens x1​,x2​,…,xN​, which we also call prompt
  • The model then generates a token at each timestep t until T: y1​,y2​,…,yT​
  • In greedy search we choose the token with the highest conditional probability from the vocabulary V
    yt​=y∈Vargmax​P(y∣y1​,y2​,…,yt−1​,x)
  • With yt​ being the chosen token at timestep t and x=(x1​,x2​,…,xN​) being the initial prompt

形式化: 提示 x, 生成 y1​…yT​. 每一步取在提示和已生成词元条件下概率最大的词: argmax.

Slide 3

Greedy search: Example

  • Suppose our vocabulary only has four tokens: A, B, C and <eos>
  • At each timestep greedy search chooses the token with the highest conditional probability
  • The model thus predicts A, B, C, <eos>
  • Its probability is 0.5 · 0.4 · 0.4 · 0.6 = 0.048

读图: 每一列是一个时间步的条件概率分布 (依赖于前面选了什么). 贪心每步取最大值 (蓝色): 第 1 步 A (0.5), 第 2 步 B (0.4), 第 3 步 C (0.4), 第 4 步 <eos> (0.6). 序列 A, B, C, <eos> 的概率是四者之积 0.048.

Slide 4

Drawbacks of greedy search (1)

  • Now we select token C at timestep 2 instead of B
  • At the timesteps 3 and 4 the conditional probabilities change since the context is no longer A, B but A, C
  • The final token sequence is A, C, B, <eos>
  • Its probability is 0.5 · 0.3 · 0.6 · 0.6 = 0.054
  • Even though C at t = 2 has a lower probability, the final sequence has a higher probability

贪心的缺点: 如果第 2 步不选最大的 B (0.4), 而选 C (0.3), 后面的条件概率就变了 (上下文是 A, C 了): 第 3 步 B 的概率 0.6, 第 4 步 <eos> 0.6. 序列 A, C, B, <eos> 的概率 0.5 · 0.3 · 0.6 · 0.6 = 0.054 > 0.048. 也就是说, 某一步选次优的词, 整个序列反而可能更优; 贪心看不到这一点.

Slide 5

Drawbacks of greedy search (2)

  • Suboptimal Global Solutions: It makes decisions based only on the highest probability token at each step, often missing globally optimal solutions
  • Lack of Diversity: It generates repetitive and predictable text, leading to bland outputs
  • Incoherence in Long Sequences: It may produce incoherent text over longer sequences due to losing track of the overall context
  • Repetitiveness: The lack of diversity leads to repetitive phrases, especially in longer texts
  • Overemphasis on Common Phrases: It favors common words and phrases, resulting in overly generic outputs

贪心的缺点总结: 常常错过全局最优; 缺乏多样性, 输出可预测、平淡; 长序列中可能不连贯; 容易重复同样的短语; 偏爱常见词和常见说法, 输出过于泛泛.

束搜索
Beam search

Slide 6
  • Core idea: Beam search extends the exploration to multiple possible sequences instead of just the most probable one
  • Exploration of search space: It explores multiple paths (or "beams") simultaneously, maintaining a set of promising candidate sequences
  • Candidate Sequence: Keeps a fixed number of most probable sequences (determined by the beam width parameter k) at each step
  • Decision Making: At each step, it considers multiple candidate sequences and selects the most probable ones based on their cumulative probabilities up to that point

Beam search 束搜索: 不只保留最可能的一个序列, 而是同时保留 k 个最有希望的候选 (k 叫束宽); 每一步扩展所有候选, 按截至当前的累积概率选出最好的 k 个. k = 1 就是贪心搜索; k = 词表大小的 T 次方 (保留一切) 就是穷举搜索.

Slide 7–8

Beam search: Example

  • Suppose V = {A, B, C, D, E} and beam width k = 2
  • At each timestep beam search chooses the k tokens with the highest joint probability
  • Suppose at t = 1 A and C have the highest conditional probabilities P(y1​∣x)
  • At t = 2 for all y2​∈V we compute:
    P(A,y2​∣x)=P(A∣x)⋅P(y2​∣A,x)P(C,y2​∣x)=P(C∣x)⋅P(y2​∣C,x)
  • And we again pick the k sequences with the highest probabilities (AB and CE)
  • At t = 3 again for all y3​∈V we compute:
    P(A,B,y2​∣x)=P(A,B∣x)⋅P(y2​∣A,B,x)P(C,E,y2​∣x)=P(C,E∣x)⋅P(y2​∣C,E,x)
  • We repeat this process unitl the maximum length is reached or unitl the <EOS> token gets generated

读图: 词表 5 个词, 束宽 2. 第 1 步: 5 个候选中保留概率最高的 A 和 C. 第 2 步: 两个候选各扩展 5 个词, 共 10 个两词序列, 按联合概率保留最高的 2 个: AB 和 CE (注意 CE 来自第 1 步的第二名 C, 贪心就不会走这条路). 第 3 步同样扩展 10 个, 保留 ABD 和 CED. 重复直到最大长度或生成 <EOS>, 最后在候选中选总概率最高的.

每一步只需算 k × |V| 个候选, 而不是 |V|t 个. 实践中常用长度归一化的分数, 否则长序列 (乘的概率多) 天然吃亏.

幻灯片小错: t = 3 的公式里变量应写 y3​, 幻灯片沿用了 y2​ (「P(A,B,y2​∣x)」). 另外「unitl」(两处) 应为 until.

Slide 9

Greedy search versus beam search

Prompt: "Once upon a time"

  • Greedy search: ", the United States was the world’s leading producer of oil and natural gas. Today, we are the world’s leading producer of coal. The United States is the world’s largest producer of oil and natural gas"
  • Beam search (beam-width 2): ", I had a friend who was a big fan of the show. He was a huge fan of the show, and I was a huge fan of the show. We would talk about the show all the time"

The generated stories are repetitive, also referred to as degenerate. These decoding strategies don’t seem to work well for the task, where more creativity and diversity might be desirable.

对比 (提示「Once upon a time」): 贪心搜索写出「美国曾是世界领先的石油和天然气生产国……美国是世界最大的石油和天然气生产国」, 完全不像童话, 而且重复; 束搜索 (束宽 2) 写出「我有个朋友是这部剧的铁杆粉丝……我们老是聊这部剧」, 「a huge fan of the show」反复出现. 这种重复的文本叫退化 (degenerate). 在需要创造力和多样性的任务 (讲故事) 上, 这两种确定性策略效果不好.

Slide 10

Beam search vs. human

  • Humans typically use words that have a low probabililty
  • Beam search though mostly outputs words which have a high probability

⇒ Incorporate some randomness (next chapter)

读图: 横轴是第几个词 (时间步), 纵轴是语言模型给这个词的概率. 束搜索生成的文本 (蓝线) 几乎每个词的概率都接近 1; 人写的文本 (橙线) 剧烈起伏, 经常用到概率很低的词. 也就是说, 人类语言并不是「每次都选最可能的词」, 恰恰相反, 信息量来自那些不太好猜的词. 所以要引入一些随机性 (8.3 节).

原文笔误: 「Holtzmann」应为 Holtzman (8.1 节写对了); 「probabililty」应为 probability; 「next chapter」指下一份课件 8.3.

8.3 随机解码与对比搜索/对比解码
Stochastic Decoding & CS/CD

学习目标
Learning goals

Slide 0 (title page)

Deep Learning for NLP — Decoding Strategies — Stochastic Decoding & CS/CD

Learning goals

  • Get to know different stochastic decoding strategies
  • Learn about sampling with temperature, top-k sampling and top-p (nucleus) sampling
  • learn about contrastive search and contrastive decoding

目标: 认识各种随机解码策略: 带温度的采样、top-k 采样、top-p (核) 采样; 了解对比搜索 (contrastive search, CS) 和对比解码 (contrastive decoding, CD).

采样
Sampling

Slide 1

Sampling motivation

  • Creativity and Variation: Sampling methods produce varied outputs for the same input, useful in creative applications like story generation and dialogue systems.
  • Avoiding Repetition: These methods are less likely to generate repetitive loops compared to deterministic methods.

为什么要采样: 同一个输入能得到不同的输出, 有创造性和变化, 适合讲故事、对话系统; 与确定性方法相比, 不容易陷入重复的循环.

Slide 2

Sampling (with temperature) (1)

The next token is selected randomly based on its conditional probability distribution. To control the randomness of the output sequence, a temperature parameter can be applied to the softmax function

σ(zi​)=∑j=1N​ezj​/tempezi​/temp​
  • temp → ∞ : Output distribution ≈ Uniform distribution
  • temp → 0 : Output distribution ≈ Point mass (Greedy search)

采样: 按条件概率分布随机抽下一个词元 (概率 0.3 的词就有 30% 的机会被选中). 用温度控制随机程度: softmax 之前把 logits 除以温度 (同 5.3 节蒸馏的温度). 温度 → ∞: 分布趋于均匀, 完全随机; 温度 → 0: 全部概率集中在最大的那个词上, 等于贪心搜索. 温度 = 1 就是模型原本的分布.

Slide 3

Prompt: "Once upon a time"

  • Sampling with low temperature: ", during the Second World War, during the final months for his three most talented young players, the coach, Harry Gregg said this"
  • Sampling with high temperature: "— well. Nowhere you call back my call, not on time; never the two on account my four. Do not come." This old woman — you might have liked, she herself — she did smile."

The generated stories are diverse but sometimes very erratic.

⇒ Sample from the top-k tokens

例: 低温采样还算通顺 (讲二战时一位教练); 高温采样语无伦次. 采样带来多样性, 但有时很混乱: 因为词表里有大量概率很小但不为零的词, 加起来的概率不小, 一旦抽中就会出错. 解决办法: 只从概率最高的 k 个词里抽.

Slide 4

Top-k sampling (Fan et al., 2018)

In Top-k sampling, the k most likely next tokens are filtered, and the probability mass is redistributed. Visualization for k = 6 in two sampling steps:

Top-k 采样: 只保留概率最高的 k 个词, 把它们的概率重新归一化 (除以它们的和), 再从中采样. 读图: k = 6. 第一步 P(w | 「The」) 比较平坦, 前 6 个词 (nice, dog, car, woman, guy, man) 只占 0.68 的概率, 很多合理的词被排除了; 第二步 P(w | 「The」, 「car」) 很尖锐, 前 6 个词占 0.99, 却仍然收进了 「down」、「a」 这类不太合适的词. 这就是固定 k 的问题: 分布平坦时 k 太小, 分布尖锐时 k 太大.

Slide 5

Prompt: "Once upon a time"

  • Top-k, k = 100: "when I was young the internet was a mysterious landscape full of new and exciting ideas. I read ebooks, watched videos, read short stories"

The quality has improved, but the fixed k might be counterproductive

⇒ Make k dynamic

k = 100 的结果通顺多了 (「我小时候互联网是个神秘的世界……」). 但固定的 k 可能适得其反 (上一页), 所以让 k 动态变化: top-p.

Slide 6

Top-p (nucleus) sampling (Holtzman et al., 2019)

Top-p sampling chooses from the smallest possible set of tokens whose cumulative probability exceeds the probability threshold p. The probability mass is then redistributed accordingly. Visualization with a threshold p = 0.92:

Top-p 采样 (核采样): 按概率从大到小累加, 取累计概率刚超过 p 的最小词集 (叫「核」, nucleus), 重新归一化后采样. 读图: p = 0.92. 平坦的 P(w | 「The」) 要 9 个词才累计到 0.94; 尖锐的 P(w | 「The」, 「car」) 只要 3 个词就到 0.97. 候选数量随分布自动调整: 模型没把握时多给机会, 有把握时只选少数几个.

Slide 7

Prompt: "Once upon a time"

  • Top-p, p = 0.92: "there were four major political parties in the United States. Since then, however, they have become even more of a novelty. For the past few decades, there have been only two."

SOTA for many years, default decoding strategy in various GPT versions, but sometimes erratic depending on p and the sampled tokens.

Question: Can there be a balance of coherence and diversity?

⇒ Contrastive search

核采样多年来是最好的方法, 是多个 GPT 版本的默认解码策略; 但取决于 p 和抽到的词, 有时也会跑偏. 问: 能否在连贯性和多样性之间取得平衡? → 对比搜索.

对比搜索
Contrastive search

Slide 8

Contrastive search (Su et al., 2022)

When generating output, contrastive search jointly considers:

  • The probability predicted by the language model to maintain the semantic coherence between the generated text and the prompt.
  • The similarity with respect to the previous context to avoid degeneration (as in Greedy or Beam search)

⇒ An "ideal" token should have a high probability and bring diversity to the story.

Empirical studies suggest k ∈ {5, 8, 10, 15} and α ∈ {0.4, 0.5, 0.6} (Su & Collier, 2023; Su & Xu, 2022; Su et al., 2022)

对比搜索同时考虑两件事: 语言模型给的概率 (保持与提示语义连贯); 与前文的相似度 (避免像贪心、束搜索那样退化重复). 理想的词元: 概率高, 同时又给故事带来新内容. 经验上 k 取 5–15, α 取 0.4–0.6.

Slide 9

Contrastive search formula I (huggingface, Tian Lan)

Let’s have a closer look at the formula for Contrastive Search:

xt​=v∈V(k)argmax​{(1−α)×model confidencepθ​(v∣x<t​)​​−α×degeneration penalty(max{s(hv​,hxj​​):1≤j≤t−1})​​}
  • xt​ is the output token and x<t​ the context
  • V(k) is the set of top-k predictions from the models probability distribution (this is the same k as in the top-k sampling from earlier)
  • pθ​(v∣x<t​), the model confidence, is the probability of a candidate token v given the context
  • max{s(hv​,hxj​​):1≤j≤t−1}, the degeneration penalty, measures how similar v is to the context, s() is the cosine similarity between the token representations

公式: 在模型预测的前 k 个候选 V(k) 中, 选使「(1 − α) × 模型置信度 − α × 退化惩罚」最大的词. 模型置信度 = 模型给这个候选的概率. 退化惩罚 = 候选词的表示 hv​ 与前文每个词元表示 hxj​​ 的余弦相似度的最大值, 即它与前文中最像的那个词有多像.

Slide 10

Contrastive search formula II

  • The degeneration penalty is defined as the maximum cosine similarity between the token representation of v, i.e hv​, and of all tokens in the context x<t​
  • hv​ is computed by the language model given the concatination of v and x<t​
  • In order to maximize the formula we want v to have a high probability and a low degeneration penalty
  • Intuitively, a larger degeneration penalty of v means it is more similar (in the representation space) to the context, therefore more likely leading to the problem of model degeneration
  • α determines how much weight to give to each component
  • For α = 0 we only consider the probability and contrastive search becomes greedy search

hv​ 是把候选 v 接在上下文后面、由语言模型算出的 v 的表示 (所以每个候选都要多算一次前向). 要让公式最大, v 要概率高、退化惩罚低. 退化惩罚大说明 v 在表示空间里与前文很像, 更可能导致重复退化. α 平衡两者; α = 0 只看概率, 对比搜索就退化成贪心搜索. 注意对比搜索是确定性的: 没有随机抽样, 只是换了打分方式.

原文笔误: 「concatination」应为 concatenation.

对比解码
Contrastive decoding

Slide 11

Contrastive decoding (Li et al., 2023)

  • Contrastive decoding exploits the contrasts between expert and amateur LM of different sizes by choosing tokens that maximize their log-likelihood difference (read the paper if you are interested, not going into more detail here!)

对比解码: 用两个大小不同的语言模型, 一个「专家」(大模型, 图中 GPT-2 XL) 和一个「业余」(小模型, GPT-2 small), 选使两者对数似然之差 logpEXP​−logpAMA​ 最大的词. 直觉: 小模型也会犯的错误 (重复、泛泛的常见词) 两者都给高概率, 相减后被抵消; 只有大模型「懂」而小模型不懂的内容才得高分.

读图: 提示「巴拉克·奥巴马出生在夏威夷檀香山. 他出生于 …」. 专家模型最看好 Hawaii (0.27), 其次是 the、Honolulu、1961. 业余模型最看好 Honolulu (0.08) 和 Washington (0.04), 对 1961 只给 0.001. 相减后, 两个模型都看好的 Honolulu (0.65) 和 Washington (−0.73) 得分很低, 只有大模型才看好的 1961 得分最高 (4.13), 是一个有信息量的新事实. 续写对比: 贪心 「Hawaii. He was born in Hawaii…」 陷入重复; 核采样 「Washington, D.C., …」事实错误; 对比解码 「1961 to a Kenyan father, Barack Hussein Obama and a mother of American descent, Stanley Ann Dunham…」 正确且有信息量.

8.4 解码超参数与实践考虑
Decoding Hyperparameters & Practical considerations

学习目标
Learning goals

Slide 0 (title page)

Deep Learning for NLP — Decoding Strategies — Decoding Hyperparameters & Practical considerations

Learning goals

  • Learn how to use the generate() function of the Transformers library
  • Learn how to choose from the different decoding strategies with the choice of hyperparameters
  • See how hyperparameters affect the output of the generate() function

目标: 学会用 Transformers 库的 generate(); 学会用超参数选择解码策略; 看超参数怎样影响输出. 这一节是 8.1–8.3 的实操版, 例子都来自 GPT-2.

Slide 1

Generating text with LLMs

In order to generate text with a generative language model you have to use their built in generate() method:

  • You need a tokenized input prompt
  • This will be the input to the model
  • Then you specify the hyperparameters of the models’ generate() method to control the output length and to choose the desired decoding strategy
  • You can find all the code in this notebook: decoding_examples.ipynb

用生成式语言模型生成文本, 要用它自带的 generate() 方法: 先把提示分词, 作为模型输入; 再设定超参数, 控制输出长度 (8.1 Slide 5–6) 并选择解码策略. 完整代码在 notebook decoding_examples.ipynb 里.

下面各页的代码省略了加载模型和分词的步骤, 完整写法大致是:

from transformers import AutoTokenizer, AutoModelForCausalLM
tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("gpt2")
model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained("gpt2")
tokenized_prompt = tok("Once upon a time", return_tensors="pt").input_ids
out = model.generate(tokenized_prompt, max_new_tokens=50)
print(tok.decode(out[0], skip_special_tokens=True))

注意采样类方法每次运行结果不同, 幻灯片里的输出只是某一次的结果; 要复现可先 torch.manual_seed(…).

Slide 2

Greedy search

The default decoding strategy is greedy search, if all the default hyperparameters are used

Prompt: "Once upon a time"

model.generate(tokenized_prompt)

Output: Once upon a time, the world was a place of great beauty and great danger. The world was a place of great danger, and the world was a place of great danger. The world was a place of great danger, and the world was a place of great danger.

全部用默认超参数时, 解码策略就是贪心搜索. 输出很快陷入重复: 「世界是个非常危险的地方」说了好几遍.

Slide 3

Beam search

In order to use beam search you simply have to add the num_beams argument to the generate() method and set it to a value > 1

Prompt: "Once upon a time"

model.generate(tokenized_prompt, num_beams=5)

Once upon a time, it was said, there would be a time when the world would be a better place. It was a time when the world would be a better place. It was a time when the world would be a better place. It was a time when the world would be a better place. It was a time when the world would be a better place.

束搜索: 把 num_beams 设为大于 1 的值 (这里 5). 输出同样严重重复. (实践中可以加 no_repeat_ngram_size=2 之类的参数禁止重复的 n-gram.)

Slide 4

Sampling with temperature (1)

In order to activate sampling you have to set do_sample=True. To additionally use temperature you have to set the temperature. Also top_k has to be set to 0, as 50 is the default value

Prompt: "Once upon a time"

model.generate(tokenized_prompt, do_sample=True,
               temperature=0.7, top_k=0)

Output: Once upon a time, we could have seen ourselves as a modern day, modern version of ourselves. Ken, who was assembled with great courage and bravery to fight for the cause of women’s reproductive rights, has been doing so for more than 15 years, and his career is full of inspiring stories. He is a poet, a civil rights leader, a hard-nosed activist and a true American hero.

启用采样: do_sample=True; 再设 temperature. 易错: top_k 默认是 50, 不设为 0 的话其实是「top-k 采样 + 温度」, 不是纯粹的温度采样. 温度 0.7 的输出通顺, 但内容随意.

Slide 5

Sampling with temperature (2)

If we set temperature to a super high value, the output distribution will approximate a uniform distribution. For temperature → 0 the output distribution will have all the probability mass in the most probable token and generate() will be equivalent to greedy search

Prompt: "Once upon a time"

model.generate(tokenized_prompt, do_sample=True,
               temperature=10000000.0, top_k=0)

Output: Once upon a time indicators Gran slew extrater rockedIA moaningJohn Chin knocking transgender Button nin forgiving submarine traveller efforts Pascal despairaways Hem Melvin Toryunn Amb velvet

This output is as expected since with such a high temperature every token in the vocabulary will have the same probability

温度设得极高 (107) 时, 分布接近均匀, 输出就是从词表里随机抽词, 完全是乱码 (连词元的片段 「extrater」, 「Toryunn」 都出来了). 温度趋于 0 时, 全部概率集中在最可能的词上, 等于贪心搜索 (实际不能设成 0, 会除以零).

Slide 6

Top-k sampling

In order to activate top-k sampling you have to set do_sample=True and set top_k to a integer > 0. If you use top_k=1 it will again be equivalent to greedy search as only the most probable token is chosen

Prompt: "Once upon a time"

model.generate(tokenized_prompt, do_sample=True,
               top_k=10)

Output: Once upon a time, he did not think he had a chance and turned to her and said:
"’My dear, what do you mean by that? I know your father, but he is dead.’
"So she said:
’I knew it. I know your father, but I do not know his whereabouts. You know my mother.’

Top-k 采样: do_sample=True 加 top_k > 0. top_k=1 又等于贪心搜索 (只剩一个候选). k = 10 的输出像一段对话, 但内容有矛盾 (「我认识你父亲, 但他死了」 / 「我知道, 我认识你父亲, 但不知道他在哪」).

原文笔误: 「to a integer」应为 an integer.

Slide 7

Top-p sampling

Set top_p to some float and do_sample=True to use top-p sampling. Using a very small value is equal to using greedy search. Using top_p=1.0 will consider all tokens

Prompt: "Once upon a time"

model.generate(tokenized_prompt, do_sample=True,
               top_p=0.7, top_k=0)

Output: Once upon a time they arrived at the well of water, they saw that their creature was burning in flames. After they had brought their clothes back to the dry land, they were found that they had died in the burning body.

Top-p 采样: do_sample=True 加一个浮点数 top_p. p 很小时, 核里只有最可能的一个词, 等于贪心; top_p=1.0 考虑所有词元 (纯采样). 同样要设 top_k=0, 否则默认的 top-k = 50 也会生效.

Slide 8

Contrastive search

For contrastive search you have to set penalty_alpha to a float and set top_k as previously mentioned. Remember we are not sampling here. For penalty_alpha=0 we only maximize the model confidence term and it becomes greedy search again. Using penalty_alpha=1 we only care about the degeneration penalty term

Prompt: "Once upon a time"

model.generate(tokenized_prompt, do_sample=True,
               penalty_alpha=0.6, top_k=20)

Output: Once upon a time, the man who had been the object of the most intense and most intense hatred, the most intense and most intense hatred, was the man who had been the object of the most intense and most intense hatred, and the man who had been the object of the most intense and most intense hatred.

对比搜索: 设 penalty_alpha (即公式里的 α) 和 top_k (候选数). 它不是采样. α = 0 只看模型置信度, 又成了贪心搜索; α = 1 只看退化惩罚 (完全不管概率, 输出会变得不通顺). 这里的输出仍然很重复.

幻灯片前后矛盾: 文字说「we are not sampling here」, 代码里却写了 do_sample=True. 在 Transformers 库里, 对比搜索是在 penalty_alpha > 0、top_k > 1 且 do_sample=False 时触发的; 加上 do_sample=True 就不会走对比搜索 (这可能也是这个输出仍然高度重复的原因). 应去掉 do_sample=True.

Slide 9

Conclusion

  • In practice you wouldn’t use one decoding strategy in isolation
  • You would have to play around with the different hyperparameters and decoding strategies until you get a good result
  • But how do we determine if a generated text is good or not?
  • For that there are several evaluation metrics → next chapter

结论: 实践中不会孤立地用一种策略, 要反复尝试各种超参数和策略的组合, 直到结果满意. 但怎么判断生成的文本好不好? 需要评价指标 → 下一份课件 (8.5).

8.5 评价指标
Evaluation Metrics

学习目标
Learning goals

Slide 0 (title page)

Deep Learning for NLP — Decoding Strategies — Evaluation Metrics

Learning goals

  • Learn about evaluation metrics for open-ended text generation
  • Get to know the different metrics with- and without a gold reference
  • Get to know potential issues with some evaluation metrics

目标: 开放式文本生成的评价指标; 有参考答案和没有参考答案时分别用什么指标; 某些指标可能的问题.

Slide 1

How do we evaluate LLMs?

How to choose the appropriate evaluation metric?

  • Does the task have a gold reference?
    • BLEU score (Papineni et al., 2002)
    • ROUGE score (Lin, 2004)
  • Are we dealing with open ended text generation without a gold reference?
    • Diversity (Su et al., 2022)
    • Coherence (Su et al., 2022)
    • MAUVE (Pillutla et al., 2021)
  • If you have the proper resources choose human evaluation

怎样选指标? 任务有标准参考答案 (gold reference) 时 (翻译、摘要): BLEU、ROUGE. 开放式生成, 没有参考答案时 (讲故事、续写): 多样性、连贯性、MAUVE. 有条件的话, 选人工评价. 前一类在 4.2 节见过.

有参考答案: BLEU 与 ROUGE
BLEU, ROUGE

Slide 2

BLEU score (1)

Given a task with a gold reference, e.g machine translation or text summarization, you compare the generated output with the given source reference to compute the BLEU score:

Five out of eight 1-grams are correctly predicted:
→ p1​=5/8

BLEU (见 3.1 Slide 3): 参考句「The guard arrived late because it was raining」, 生成句「The guard arrived late because of the rain」. 生成句有 8 个 1-gram, 其中 The, guard, arrived, late, because 这 5 个出现在参考句里 (第二个 「the」 不算, 因为参考句只有一个 the, 计数被截断), p1​=5/8.

Slide 3

BLEU score (2)

Four out of seven 2-grams are correctly predicted:
→ p2​=4/7

You keep doing this procedure until N n-grams and compute a weighted geometric average over the precision scores with weights wn​:

exp(n=1∑N​wn​⋅log(pn​))

2-gram: 生成句有 7 个, 匹配的是 「The guard」, 「guard arrived」, 「arrived late」, 「late because」 4 个 (绿线), p2​=4/7. 一直算到 N-gram, 再取加权几何平均. 我按定义用 Python 数过这两个比例.

Slide 4

BLEU score - brevity penalty

In order to penalize very short predictions (it’s more likely for shorter sentences to achieve a good precision score) the BLEU score additionally has a brevity penalty term:

BP={1,e(1−r/c),​if c>rif c≤r​
  • With r being the reference corpus length and c the candidate corpus length

The final formula is then:

BLEU=BP⋅exp(n=1∑N​wn​⋅log(pn​))

简短惩罚: 短句更容易拿到高精确率 (只说一两个最有把握的词), 所以生成的长度 c 不超过参考长度 r 时乘以 e1−r/c (小于 1); 更长时不惩罚. 例: 本例 c = 8, r = 8, BP = e0 = 1.

Slide 5

ROUGE score

  • The ROUGE (Recall-Oriented Understudy for Gisting Evaluation) is a metric commonly used for evaluating the quality of machine-generated text, particularly summaries
  • ROUGE measures the similarity between the generated summary and one or more reference (human-written) summaries
  • ROUGE includes multiple metrics, such as ROUGE-N (for n-grams), ROUGE-L (for longest common subsequence), and ROUGE-W (for weighted n-grams). Depending on the task, these metrics capture different aspects of summary quality, allowing a more comprehensive evaluation

ROUGE (面向召回的要旨评估替补): 主要用于评价摘要, 衡量生成的摘要与一个或多个人写的参考摘要的相似度. 有多种变体: ROUGE-N (n-gram 重合)、ROUGE-L (最长公共子序列, 不要求连续)、ROUGE-W (加权, 偏好连续的匹配). 名字里的「Recall-Oriented」: BLEU 看精确率 (生成的东西有多少是对的), ROUGE 主要看召回率 (参考里的内容有多少被覆盖了).

幻灯片说法不准确: ROUGE-W 是「加权的最长公共子序列」(weighted LCS), 不是「weighted n-grams」.

Slide 6

Example: ROUGE-1 precision

Consider the following source sentence S and candidate summary C:

  • S: The cat is on the mat.
  • C: The cat and the dog.

Using the ROUGE-N precision score with N = 1 you get:

  • Three correctly predicted unigrams
  • Total of number of unigrams in C is 5

→ ROUGE-1 precision = 3/5 = 0.6

There are more ROUGE scores as mentioned earlier. You can find more details here: Medium, Fabio Chiusano

例: 参考 S「The cat is on the mat.」, 候选 C「The cat and the dog.」. C 的 5 个 unigram 中, the (2 次, 参考里也有 2 次)、cat 匹配, 共 3 个, ROUGE-1 精确率 = 3/5 = 0.6. 对应的 ROUGE-1 召回率 = 3/6 = 0.5 (参考有 6 个 unigram: the, cat, is, on, the, mat). 忽略句号.

幻灯片小错: S 是参考摘要 (reference), 不是「source sentence」 (源句是被摘要的原文); 「Total of number」应为 Total number. 而且 ROUGE 名为「面向召回」, 例子却只算了精确率.

无参考答案的指标
Metrics without a gold reference

Slide 7
  • BLEU and ROUGE are both used for tasks that have a gold reference you can compare your prediction to
  • In open ended text generation you just have a prompt and an output generated by the model
  • You don’t have any gold reference to compare your output to
  • Therefore you have to get a bit more creative with the choice of evaluation metrics

BLEU 和 ROUGE 都需要参考答案. 开放式生成只有提示和模型的输出, 没有标准答案可比 (同一个故事开头可以有无数好的续写), 只能另想办法.

Slide 8

Diversity

Su et al., 2022 define diversity in their paper, where they introduce contrastive search, as the generation repetition at different n-gram levels:

  • Generation Repitition:
    • Measures the sequence-level repitition as the portion of duplicate n-grams in the generated text
    • For a generated text continuation xcont​ the repitition at n-gram level is defined as:
      rep-n=100×(1.0−∣total n-grams(xcont​)∣∣unique n-grams(xcont​)∣​)

多样性 (Su 等提出对比搜索时定义的): 先定义 n-gram 级别的重复率: 生成文本中重复的 n-gram 所占比例. rep-n = 100 × (1 − 不同 n-gram 数 / n-gram 总数). 例: 「a b a b」的 2-gram 是 ab, ba, ab, 总数 3, 不同的 2 个, rep-2 = 100 × (1 − 2/3) ≈ 33.3.

原文笔误: 「Repitition / repitition」(多处) 应为 Repetition.

Slide 9

Diversity (2)

  • Diversity:
    • Repitition at different n-gram levels:
      DIV=n=2∏4​(1.0−100rep-n​)
    • Plugging in rep-n from the previous slide, this expression simplifies to:
      DIV=n=2∏4​∣total n-grams(xcont​)∣∣unique n-grams(xcont​)∣​
    • A low diversity score suggests the model suffers from repitition, and a high diversity score means the model-generated text is lexically diverse

多样性 DIV = 2-gram、3-gram、4-gram 三个级别「不重复比例」的乘积, 在 0 到 1 之间. 分数低说明模型有重复问题; 分数高说明用词多样. 例如 8.2、8.4 节那些反复说「the world was a place of great danger」的输出, DIV 会很低.

Slide 10

Coherence

This measure was also proposed by Su et al., 2022 as the cosine similarity between the sentence embeddings of the prompt xprompt​ and a generated text conitinuation xcont​:

  • They use pre-trained SimCSE sentence embeddings EMB(x) proposed by Gao et al., 2022:
    COH(xcont​,xprompt​)=∥EMB(xprompt​)∥⋅∥EMB(xcont​)∥EMB(xprompt​)⋅EMB(xcont​)​
  • The higher the coherence-score the better the model-generated text fits to the given prompt

连贯性 (同样出自 Su 等): 用预训练的 SimCSE 句子嵌入分别编码提示和续写, 算两者的余弦相似度. 越高说明续写与提示越相关. 多样性和连贯性往往此消彼长: 高温采样多样但不连贯, 贪心搜索连贯但重复; 对比搜索的目标就是两者兼顾.

原文笔误: 「conitinuation」应为 continuation. SimCSE (Gao, Yao & Chen) 发表于 2021 年 (EMNLP 2021), 不是 2022.

MAUVE
MAUVE

Slide 11

MAUVE (Pillutla et al., 2021)

  • A language model is an estimate P^(x) of the probability distribution over sequences of text x=(x1​,…,x∣x∣​), consisting of tokens xt​ belonging to a fixed vocabulary
  • Given a context x1:t​, a language model P^ and a stochastic decoding strategy we generate text by sampling x^t+1​∼P^(⋅∣x1:t​), x^t+2​∼P^(⋅∣x1:t​,x^t+1​), etc.
  • The decoding strategy and the language model taken together define a distribution Q over text, which we call model distribution
  • The goal of MAUVE is to measure the gap between the model distribution Q and the target distribution P

MAUVE: 语言模型 P^ 是对文本分布的估计; 加上一种 (随机) 解码策略, 就能逐词采样生成文本. 模型和解码策略合在一起定义了一个文本分布 Q (模型分布). MAUVE 衡量 Q 与人类文本的真实分布 P 之间的差距. 注意它评价的是整个「模型 + 解码策略」系统, 而且比较的是分布, 不是单个句子.

Slide 12

Sources of error in text generation I

  • The gap between Q and P arises from two sources of error
  • Type I error: Q places high mass on text which is unlikely under P
  • Type II error: Q cannot generate text which is plausible under P

Q 与 P 的差距有两个来源:

  • 第一类错误: Q 在 P 下不太可能的文本上放了很多概率, 即模型生成了人不会写的文本 (退化、重复, 图右「The time is the time is…」).
  • 第二类错误: Q 生成不了 P 下合理的文本, 即模型覆盖不了人类文本的多样性 (图右的冷门地名例子, 截断式采样把这类低概率但合理的文本排除了).

读图: 左边: MAUVE 比较 Q 与 P, 通过一族混合分布 Rλ​. 右边: 横轴是文本, 两条曲线是 P 和 Q; Q 在左侧有 P 没有的峰 (第一类错误), 在右侧缺了 P 的峰 (第二类错误).

Slide 13

Sources of error in text generation II

  • They formalize the two errors through the Kullback-Leibler divergence:
    • KL(Q|P) penalizes Q if there is a text x that leads to a high Q(x) but a low P(x), which is the Type I error
    • Similarly the Type II error is defined by KL(P|Q)
  • Issue: both KL divergences are infinite if the supports of Q and P are not identical
  • The authors overcome this issue by softly measuring the two errors with a mixture distribution:
    Rλ​=λP(1−λ)Qfor λ∈(0,1)
  • (soft) Type I error: KL(Q,Rλ​)
  • (soft) Type II error: KL(P,Rλ​)

用 KL 散度形式化两类错误: KL(Q∥P)=∑x​Q(x)logP(x)Q(x)​ 在 Q(x) 大而 P(x) 小时很大, 对应第一类错误; KL(P∥Q) 对应第二类错误. 问题: 只要两个分布的支撑集不完全相同 (某些文本一方概率为 0 另一方不为 0), KL 就是无穷大. 解决: 改为与混合分布 Rλ​=λP+(1−λ)Q 比较, 混合分布在两者任一方非零的地方都非零, KL 就有限了.

幻灯片错误: 混合分布漏了加号, 应为 Rλ​=λP+(1−λ)Q (下一页写对了).

Slide 14

Divergence curve

To capture all the possible values of the mixture weight λ they vary λ between 0 and 1 to generate a divergence curve:

C(P,Q)={(exp(−cKL(Q∥Rλ​)),exp(−cKL(P∥Rλ​))):Rλ​=λP+(1−λ)Q,λ∈(0,1)}

MAUVE(P, Q) is the area under this divergence curve, it is a summary of the trade-off between Type I and II errors and lies in (0,1] (more details can be found in the paper Pillutla et al., 2021)

让 λ 从 0 变到 1, 每个 λ 给出一个点 (两类软错误各取 exp(−c·KL), 映射到 (0, 1] 内, 越大越好), 连成散度曲线. MAUVE = 曲线下的面积, 概括了两类错误的权衡, 取值在 (0, 1], 越接近 1 说明 Q 越接近 P. c 是一个缩放常数.

读图: 四个小图分别比较不同大小的 GPT-2、不同大小的 Grover、GPT-2 large 上不同的解码算法、Grover base 上的解码算法. 阴影是曲线下面积 (MAUVE): 模型越大面积越大; 核采样比贪心和祖先采样 (直接按分布采样) 更接近人类文本.

人工评价
Human evaluation

Slide 15–16

Why Human Evaluation?

  • Subjectivity of Quality: Human judgments are essential for evaluating the nuanced quality of text that automatic metrics might miss, such as humor, creativity, and relevance

Key Considerations

  • Evaluators: Use domain experts or crowdworkers, depending on the task complexity
  • Evaluation Criteria:
    • Fluency: Is the generated text grammatically correct and natural-sounding?
    • Coherence: Does the text make logical sense?
    • Diversity: Is the output lexically diverse?
  • Challenges:
    • Subjectivity: Different evaluators might have varying opinions, leading to inconsistency
    • Cost and Time: Human evaluation is resource-intensive
    • Bias: Evaluators might bring in their biases, which can skew results

为什么需要人工评价: 质量是主观的, 幽默、创意、相关性这些细微之处自动指标抓不住. 要考虑: 评估者 (按任务难度选领域专家或众包工人); 评价标准 (流畅: 语法正确、自然; 连贯: 逻辑通顺; 多样: 用词丰富). 挑战: 主观性 (评估者意见不一致, 通常要算评估者间一致性); 成本和时间; 评估者自己的偏见会影响结果. 同 4.2 Slide 20.
